name: set_timer
description: Start a countdown on WinIsland. Set seconds to 0 to cancel the current timer. Maximum duration is 24 hours.

name: open_app
description: Open an installed Windows application by its Start menu name, or open a Windows settings page using an ms-settings: URI. This does not execute arbitrary commands or files.

name: open_url
description: Open an HTTP or HTTPS URL in the user's default browser.

name: web_search
description: Open a browser search results page. This does not fetch or read the search results; use it when the user wants to view results in their browser.

name: media_control
description: Control the current media session or system volume. percent defaults to 10 for volume_up and volume_down, and is required for set_volume.

name: get_weather
description: Fetch current weather and a three-day forecast. Use the user's city if given. An omitted city uses approximate public-IP location; if location cannot be determined, ask the user for their city.

name: read
description: Read UTF-8 text or list a directory within the configured working directory or additional read-only directories. Text output includes line numbers and a SHA-256 hash.

name: write
description: Write a UTF-8 file inside the working directory. Requires write permission. Supply expected_sha256 when replacing content that was read earlier. Prefer update for changes to selected lines.

name: update
description: Preview a unified diff for an inclusive, one-based line range. preview requires path, start_line, end_line and replacement content. Use end_line=start_line-1 to insert. Then apply the returned change_id to write exactly that preview; write permission and an unchanged source file are required.

name: execute
description: Execute a PowerShell command in the configured working directory, only when execute permission is enabled. The directory is not an OS sandbox. Do not bypass disabled read/write permissions or access unauthorized directories. Output and execution time are bounded.
